goal: Prevent addresses on different networks from sharing the same internal key representation
Stop nodes from incorrectly suppressing address relay across networks like Tor and I2P
agreement: Suggested using an unreachable assertion to ensure switch exhaustiveness (l0rinc)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because cross-network address collisions in relay filters are a rare cryptographic edge case
It improves address relay correctness without fixing an urgent vulnerability
